title: IPv6 Static and Default Route Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose and resolve IPv6 static routing faults, next-hop errors, and missing default routes across a multi-router hub-and-spoke enterprise topology.
learning_objectives: Identify common IPv6 static routing configuration errors including incorrect next-hop addresses and missing return routes
Configure IPv6 default static routes (::/0) on branch edge routers directing traffic to the central hub
Configure recursive and directly connected IPv6 static routes across multi-hop router paths
Interpret and verify the Cisco IOS IPv6 routing table using 'show ipv6 route' across connected and static routes
Verify end-to-end multi-hop IPv6 reachability and path symmetry using ICMPv6 echo and traceroute
Systematically troubleshoot packet blackholing caused by asymmetric routing and missing return routes

source.origin: Independently authored IPv6 multi-hop static routing and troubleshooting curriculum guide based on CCNA enterprise routing standards
